name: msvc-extended-aligned-storage
title: MSVC: define _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE so stable_sort over over-aligned types compiles (C2338 in TextDrawing.cpp)
issue: Bug report from the user (2026-10-14), building master with build-vs.bat (Debug, VS 2022 Build Tools, MSVC 14.44.35207) on a second PC: engine/src/rendering/TextDrawing.cpp(145) fails with `error C2338: static_assert failed: You've instantiated std::aligned_storage<Len, Align> with an extended alignment ... define either _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE ... or _DISABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE`. Instantiation chain: `std::ranges::stable_sort` (TextDrawing.cpp:145, in TextDrawing::ResolvePasses, element type `ResolvePasses::Entry`, 80 bytes, alignment 16 because it contains over-aligned math types) -> `std::_Optimistic_temporary_buffer<Entry>` -> `std::_Aligned_storage_t<80,16>`. Our CI Windows legs are green (their MSVC toolset apparently differs), so this is a toolset-dependent STL behaviour that our code can trip. Fix: (1) in the root CMakeLists.txt MSVC block (and for clang-cl: the `MSVC` variable is true there too; check the `WIN32 AND Clang` branch for the MSVC STL case) add the compile definition `_ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE` for ALL targets (add_compile_definitions inside if(MSVC), or the clang-cl equivalent when it uses the MSVC STL), with a short comment explaining why (MSVC STL temporary buffers for over-aligned element types; we compile everything in one build so the layout change is harmless). Do NOT use _DISABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE. Also check engine/ tests/ renderer/ text/ math/ for any CMake target that sets its own compile definitions in a way that would bypass a global add_compile_definitions (target_compile_definitions are additive; fine) and for other places where an over-aligned type goes through std::stable_sort/std::stable_partition/std::inplace_merge/std::get_temporary_buffer (grep the repo, list them in the PR body; no code change needed if the definition is global). (2) A regression test (tests/engine or tests/math, registered like the neighbours) that stable-sorts a std::vector of a struct `alignas(16)` of 80 bytes with `std::ranges::stable_sort` AND `std::stable_sort` and asserts the result is stably sorted (equal keys keep order) for sizes around the temporary-buffer threshold (0, 1, 2, 7, 64, 1000): on a toolset that rejects extended aligned storage without the definition this file fails to COMPILE, which is the point. The test must compile and pass on every leg (Linux Clang/GCC, arm64, Windows). (3) Docs: one line in docs/testing.html or the build docs (find where MSVC build notes live) mentioning the definition. Nothing builds locally; CI is the build (8 checks, required `linux (Release, x86_64, Clang)`). Keep the change minimal.
acceptance: _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE defined for every target on MSVC builds
Regression test stable-sorts an alignas(16) 80-byte type with both std:: and std::ranges:: variants
Minimal diff: no engine source changes
notes: Reviewer: confirm the definition reaches EVERY target including tests and lua_project and the googletest/OpenAL FetchContent targets are unaffected or fine, it is inside the MSVC (and clang-cl with MSVC STL) condition only, not applied on Linux/Clang libstdc++, and the test would fail to compile without it on the user's toolset (MSVC 14.44.35207). Unverified: the user's PC (the user will rebuild there).
